teaser.en: Before iron nails came from abroad, there was the 'hinterland nail': pegs cut from this tree's hard wood.
teaser.sw: Kabla misumari ya chuma haijaletwa kutoka ng'ambo, kulikuwa na 'msumari wa bara': vigingi vilivyochongwa kutoka mbao ngumu za mti huu.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya misumari ya chuma kpwedza kula ng'ambo, kala kuna 'msumari wa bara': vipande vya mbao vinavyokatwa kula nyama ngumu za muhi uhu.

summary.en: *Mvamva* is a tree of bushed grassland and coastal forest with purple pea flowers, velvety pods and very hard wood. That wood is made into wooden nails, which gave it the name *msumari bara*, 'hinterland nail'.
summary.sw: *Mvamva* ni mti wa nyika zenye vichaka na misitu ya pwani wenye maua ya zambarau kama ya kunde, maganda yenye manyoya laini kama velvet na mbao ngumu sana. Mbao hizo hutengenezwa kuwa misumari ya mbao, jambo lililoupa jina *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara'.
summary.dg: *Mvamva* ni muhi wa nyasi zenye vitsaka na wa matsaka ga pwani, wenye maruwa ga zambarau dza ga kunde, makakaya genye nyere laini na nyama za muhi ngumu sana. Nyama hizo nkuhendwa misumari ya mbao, na ndiyo mana ukaihwa *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara'.

about.en: *Mvamva* is a tree with pinnate leaves and purple pea-flowers, followed by velvety pods. The wood is hard.
about.sw: *Mvamva* ni mti wenye majani yaliyogawanyika kama manyoya na maua ya zambarau kama ya kunde, yanayofuatwa na maganda yenye manyoya laini kama velvet. Mbao zake ni ngumu.
about.dg: *Mvamva* ni muhi wenye makodza ga kuungana, genye makodza madide airi-airi, na maruwa ga zambarau ga umbo dza maruwa ga kunde, na bada yao kunatuluka makakaya genye nyere laini. Nyama za muhi ni ngumu.

where.en: It grows in bushed grassland and coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye vichaka na misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasi zenye vitsaka na kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: The hard wood is made into wooden nails.
uses.sw: Mbao ngumu hutengenezwa kuwa misumari ya mbao.
uses.dg: Nyama ngumu za muhi nkuhendwa misumari ya mbao.

culture.en: Its second name, *msumari bara*, 'hinterland nail', marks the difference between nails made at home from this wood and imported iron nails (Pakia).
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili, *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', linaonyesha tofauti kati ya misumari iliyotengenezwa nyumbani kwa mbao hizi na misumari ya chuma iliyoletwa kutoka nje (Pakia).
culture.dg: Dzinare ra phiri, *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', rinaonyesa tafwauti kahi ya misumari iriyohendwa kaya kula nyama za muhi uhu na misumari ya chuma iriyorehwa kula ng'ambo (Pakia).

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mvamva*, which is shared with Duruma, and *msumari bara*, 'hinterland nail', which is also the Swahili name. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mvamva*, linalotumiwa pia na Waduruma, na *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: *mvamva*, ambaro piya ni ra Chiduruma, na *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana.

reason.en: Another tree with heavy, hard wood
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wenye mbao nzito na ngumu
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wenye mbao ngumu na nziho

reason.en: Named after the object made from it
reason.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na kitu kinachotengenezwa kwake
reason.dg: Muhi ambao dzinare rinalavywa kula chitu chinachohendwa kpwa mbaoze

reason.en: Wood made into a household tool
reason.sw: Mbao zinazotengenezwa kuwa chombo cha nyumbani
